variations.name: Pure-play battery-electric carmakers
variations.description: Companies founded to build only battery-electric vehicles, using clean-sheet engineering, software-first architectures and direct sales to set the cost and performance benchmarks that pull the whole car market toward electrification.

companies.name: Tesla
companies.what: Vertically integrated BEV maker (Model 3/Y, 4680 cells, Supercharger network, FSD software) that proved EVs at scale.
companies.signal: 1.64M deliveries in 2025, down 8.6% — second straight annual decline; lost global BEV crown to BYD

companies.name: BYD
companies.what: Fully vertically integrated from Blade LFP cells to finished cars; world's largest NEV maker, dropped ICE-only production in 2022.
companies.signal: 2.26M BEVs sold in 2025 (+28%), overtaking Tesla as #1 global BEV seller; ~4M+ total NEVs/yr

companies.name: NIO
companies.what: Premium BEVs differentiated by battery-swap network and battery-as-a-service, plus Onvo and Firefly mass-market sub-brands.
companies.signal: ~326k deliveries 2025 (+47% YoY); 3,000+ swap stations in China; still loss-making

companies.name: XPeng
companies.what: Smart-EV maker focused on in-house ADAS/autonomy software; Mona M03 brought its stack to the mass market; licenses platform/software to Volkswagen.
companies.signal: 429,445 deliveries in 2025, +126% YoY

companies.name: Rivian
companies.what: US adventure-positioned electric trucks/SUVs (R1T/R1S) with in-house zonal electronics; mid-size R2 platform targets volume.
companies.signal: ~50k vehicles/yr; Volkswagen software JV worth up to $5.8B; R2 launches 2026 from Normal, IL

companies.name: Lucid Motors
companies.what: Ultra-efficient luxury EVs (Air sedan, Gravity SUV) with class-leading range from in-house powertrains; supplies tech to Aston Martin.
companies.signal: Saudi PIF majority-backed with repeated billion-dollar infusions; Gravity ramped through 2025; founder-CEO Rawlinson stepped down Feb 2025; volumes still ~20k/yr

companies.name: VinFast
companies.what: Vietnamese conglomerate-backed BEV maker expanding aggressively into India and Indonesia with low-cost models.
companies.signal: 196,919 deliveries 2025 (2x YoY) but ~$4.0B net loss, -43% gross margin and going-concern doubt; $13.5B+ funneled in by Vingroup/founder

companies.name: Zeekr
companies.what: Geely's premium BEV brand on the SEA platform with 800V fast-charging focus; briefly NYSE-listed.
companies.signal: ~90.7k H1 2025 deliveries; Geely completed ~$2.4B privatization and NYSE delisting Dec 2025

companies.name: Fisker
companies.what: Asset-light BEV model — designed the Ocean SUV and outsourced manufacturing to Magna Steyr — that collapsed on quality and cash problems.
companies.signal: ~11k Oceans built; Chapter 11 June 2024 after burning ~$1B+

companies.name: Slate Auto
companies.what: Bezos-backed minimalist sub-$30k modular electric pickup (no paint, no infotainment) attacking EV affordability in the US.
companies.signal: $650M Series C (Apr 2026); 160k+ reservations; production targeted late 2026 in Warsaw, Indiana

variations.name: Incumbent OEM EV programs & sub-brands
variations.description: Legacy automakers electrifying through dedicated EV platforms and sub-brands, converting existing factories, dealer networks and supply chains to electric at multi-hundred-thousand-unit scale.

companies.name: Volkswagen Group (ID. / MEB-PPE)
companies.what: Europe's BEV volume leader with the MEB/PPE platforms across VW ID., Audi, Skoda, Cupra; next-gen SSP plus Rivian software JV.
companies.signal: ID. family well past 1M cumulative; ~745k group BEVs in 2024; $5.8B Rivian JV

companies.name: General Motors (Ultium)
companies.what: Shared Ultium battery/platform architecture spanning Chevy Equinox/Blazer EV and Cadillac Lyriq, with cells from JV plants with LG.
companies.signal: #2 US EV seller in 2025 behind Tesla; pulled back some EV capacity after US tax credit expired Sept 2025

companies.name: Hyundai Motor Group (Ioniq / E-GMP)
companies.what: 800V E-GMP platform underpinning Hyundai Ioniq 5/6/9 and Kia EV3-EV9; among the most awarded incumbent EV programs.
companies.signal: Metaplant America (Georgia) opened 2025; E-GMP models sell globally at scale; EREV variants announced for ~2027

companies.name: BMW (i / Neue Klasse)
companies.what: BMW i sub-brand transitioning to the dedicated 800V Neue Klasse platform (iX3 first), built in Debrecen and Munich.
companies.signal: ~426k BEVs delivered 2024 (+13.5%); Neue Klasse iX3 launched at IAA 2025

companies.name: Toyota (bZ)
companies.what: Deliberately slow 'multi-pathway' BEV program (bZ4X/bZ line) while betting on solid-state batteries around 2027-28.
companies.signal: BEVs still ~1-2% of Toyota's ~10M annual sales; bZ lineup expanded 2025

companies.name: Geely Group
companies.what: China's #2 NEV group spanning Galaxy, Zeekr, Volvo, Polestar, smart and Lynk & Co, consolidated around the SEA architecture.
companies.signal: Completed Zeekr privatization Dec 2025 (~$2.4B) to tighten premium EV strategy; millions of NEVs/yr group-wide

companies.name: Stellantis
companies.what: STLA Small/Medium/Large platforms across 14 brands; the €23k Citroën ë-C3 is Europe's affordability play; 51% JV distributes Leapmotor EVs outside China.
companies.signal: ë-C3 launched 2024; Leapmotor International selling in 20+ countries; several US BEV programs delayed in favor of EREV/hybrids

companies.name: Tata Motors
companies.what: Dominates India's nascent EV market with low-cost Nexon EV, Punch EV and Tiago EV on the Acti.ev platform.
companies.signal: ~60%+ share of Indian EV sales; TPG-backed EV unit valued ~$9B

companies.name: Renault (Ampere / R5 E-Tech)
companies.what: Carved out Ampere as a dedicated EV/software unit; retro-styled Renault 5 E-Tech is Europe's headline affordable EV.
companies.signal: R5 E-Tech named 2025 European Car of the Year; Ampere targets BEV-ICE cost parity by ~2027-28

variations.name: Extended-range EV (EREV) specialists
variations.description: Vehicles always driven by electric motors but carrying a small gasoline generator to recharge the battery, eliminating range anxiety with smaller, cheaper packs — the fastest-growing powertrain category in China and now being adopted for US trucks.

companies.name: Li Auto
companies.what: Pioneered premium family-SUV EREVs (L6-L9) in China and remains the segment leader; expanding into BEVs (Mega, i8).
companies.signal: 1.4M+ cumulative deliveries by Sept 2025; L6 was China's best-selling EREV for 7 straight months; growth flattened in 2025

companies.name: Leapmotor
companies.what: Budget-priced dual-powertrain strategy — every model offered as BEV or REEV (C10/C11) — with Stellantis distributing internationally.
companies.signal: 596,555 deliveries 2025 (+103%), top Chinese NEV startup by volume; C10 REEV one of only two EREVs on sale in Europe

companies.name: Seres (AITO, with Huawei)
companies.what: Builds the Huawei-co-developed AITO M7/M8/M9 EREV SUVs, China's top-selling premium SUVs above RMB 400-500k.
companies.signal: Updated AITO M7 took 100k+ pre-orders within 1 hour (Sept 2025); M9 dominates China's ultra-premium SUV segment

companies.name: Scout Motors (VW Group)
companies.what: Reborn American off-road brand whose Terra pickup and Traveler SUV offer a 'Harvester' gasoline range-extender option alongside pure BEV.
companies.signal: $2B Blythewood, SC plant under construction; production from 2027; reservations reportedly skew heavily to the Harvester EREV

companies.name: Stellantis (Ram 1500 Ramcharger)
companies.what: First high-volume US EREV pickup — V6 acts purely as a generator for ~690 miles total range; prioritized over the canceled pure-BEV Ram.
companies.signal: Launch slipped to 2026-27 as Stellantis re-sequenced its EV truck lineup around EREV demand

companies.name: Mazda (MX-30 R-EV)
companies.what: Niche rotary-engine range extender packaging — one of only two EREVs on sale in Europe as of 2025.
companies.signal: Low volumes; mainly a technology demonstrator for Mazda's rotary-generator approach

variations.name: Solar-integrated EVs
variations.description: Ultra-efficient vehicles with photovoltaic body panels that harvest enough sunlight to add daily driving range and cut charging dependence — viable only on very light, aerodynamic designs because car surfaces cap on-board PV at roughly 1 kW.

companies.name: Aptera Motors
companies.what: Three-wheeled ~10 mi/kWh composite solar EV claiming up to ~40 miles/day from sunlight alone.
companies.signal: $130M+ crowdfunded plus $75M equity line (Oct 2025); validation assembly line running 2025; first sales pushed to late 2026, volume production ~2028 pending ~$60M more

companies.name: Lightyear (Atlas Technologies)
companies.what: Built the €250k Lightyear 0, the first production solar car, then pitched a €40k Lightyear 2 before running out of money.
companies.signal: Parent declared bankruptcy Jan 2023 weeks after first deliveries; ~40k Lightyear 2 pre-orders never fulfilled; remnants pivoted to licensing solar roof tech

companies.name: Sono Motors
companies.what: Canceled its crowdfunded Sion solar car after insolvency and pivoted to retrofit solar kits for buses and trucks (customers include Mitsubishi Europe, CHEREAU, Scania, MAN).
companies.signal: Sion program scrapped Feb 2023 with ~45k reservations; relaunched post-insolvency as a solar-retrofit supplier; Sion prototypes auctioned Aug 2025

companies.name: Squad Mobility
companies.what: Dutch maker of the Squad Solar City Car, a sub-€10k L6e/LSV quadricycle whose roof panel adds ~20 km/day of urban range.
companies.signal: First customer deliveries in the Netherlands from 2024-25; targeting US LSV market

companies.name: Hyundai (solar roof options)
companies.what: Offers factory solar-roof options on models like the Ioniq 5 and Sonata — solar as a supplemental feature rather than primary energy source.
companies.signal: Solar roof adds only ~1,300-2,000 km/yr; remains a low-take-rate option

variations.white_space: Both flagship solar-car startups failed (Lightyear bankrupt, Sono's Sion canceled) and Aptera is still pre-revenue after years — physics caps on-vehicle PV near 1 kW, so a standalone 'solar carmaker' only pencils with extreme lightweighting. The credible opening is solar as a feature: OEM roof options, retrofit kits for fleets, and sun-rich-market microcars/LSVs where 20-40 km/day of free range covers most trips.

variations.name: Microcars, quadricycles & low-speed EVs
variations.description: Sub-car-sized electric vehicles (EU L6e/L7e quadricycles, China's A00 mini-EVs, US low-speed vehicles) that electrify short urban trips using a fraction of the battery, materials, cost and parking space of a full-size EV.

companies.name: SAIC-GM-Wuling (Hongguang Mini EV)
companies.what: Makes the world's best-selling micro EV, a ~$4-5k city car profitable without subsidies.
companies.signal: 435,598 units sold in 2025 alone; 1.85M+ cumulative since 2020; 5th generation unveiled Feb 2026

companies.name: Stellantis (Citroën Ami / Fiat Topolino / Opel Rocks-e)
companies.what: Mass-produced ~€8k L6e quadricycle drivable from age 14 in France, sold through vending-machine-simple retail.
companies.signal: 75,000+ units across 18 markets since 2020; France's best-selling quadricycle

companies.name: Micro Mobility Systems (Microlino)
companies.what: Swiss kick-scooter maker building the premium bubble-car-styled Microlino L7e quadricycle in Turin.
companies.signal: ~3,700 vehicles produced in 2024, first full production year; ~£20k price point

companies.name: Renault Mobilize (Duo)
companies.what: 80 km/h two-seat quadricycle sold partly by subscription, Renault's bet on sub-car urban mobility.
companies.signal: Launched 2025 in Europe as the Ami's direct upmarket competitor

companies.name: Eli Electric (Eli Zero)
companies.what: Builds a $11,990 neighborhood electric vehicle (NEV/LSV) targeting US suburbs, already sold as an L6e in Europe.
companies.signal: US deliveries to reservation holders began 2025 after regulatory delays

companies.name: NIU Technologies
companies.what: Chinese smart-scooter maker moving up into a scooter-priced enclosed electric microcar.
companies.signal: Microcar confirmed headed to production (Nov 2025); leverages existing two-wheeler retail network

companies.name: ElectraMeccanica
companies.what: Canadian maker of the single-seat Solo three-wheeler — recalled and bought back every vehicle in 2023, ending the program.
companies.signal: All ~400 Solos repurchased Feb 2023; vehicle business wound down and shell merged with Xos in 2024

companies.name: Arcimoto
companies.what: Oregon maker of the three-wheeled 'Fun Utility Vehicle' tandem EV that could never get unit costs below price.
companies.signal: Production halted since 2023 amid funding collapse, mass layoffs and delisting threats; no credible restart

variations.white_space: Crowded in Europe and China but nearly empty in the US, where no federal quadricycle class exists and the 25 mph low-speed-vehicle rule strands products between golf carts and cars — a regulatory void that helped kill Arcimoto and ElectraMeccanica. An opening exists for whoever cracks US homologation (a 35-45 mph 'medium-speed' class or state-level carve-outs) with a sub-$12k product like Eli's.

variations.name: EV skateboard platforms & contract manufacturers
variations.description: Companies that sell modular EV rolling chassis ('skateboards') or assemble complete EVs under contract, letting brands launch vehicles without owning factories or full-stack engineering — attempting to do for cars what Foxconn did for phones.

companies.name: Foxconn / Foxtron
companies.what: Electronics giant's EV arm offering the open MIH platform and contract assembly; its Model C sells as the Luxgen n7 in Taiwan.
companies.signal: Acquired Luxgen brand for ~$25M Dec 2025; MOU to supply Mitsubishi-badged EVs for Oceania from H2 2026; n7 was Taiwan's #2 EV at launch

companies.name: Magna Steyr
companies.what: Veteran full-vehicle contract manufacturer in Graz (built Jaguar I-Pace and Fisker Ocean) with its own EV platform engineering services.
companies.signal: Lost anchor EV client when Fisker went bankrupt 2024; Graz capacity underutilized, actively courting new EV programs

companies.name: REE Automotive
companies.what: Israeli developer of REEcorner x-by-wire modules packing motor, steering, brakes and suspension into the wheel corners of a flat skateboard.
companies.signal: P7-C was first fully by-wire vehicle FMVSS-certified in the US; ~$60M order book; pivoting toward licensing its software-defined-vehicle stack amid cash constraints

companies.name: U Power Technology
companies.what: Chinese 'UP Super Board' skateboard chassis venture aiming to supply niche brands and ride-hailing OEMs.
companies.signal: Nasdaq-listed 2023 (UCAR) but minimal vehicle revenue; little verified commercial traction since

companies.name: Canoo
companies.what: Built lifestyle vans and pickups on a steer-by-wire skateboard it once pitched as a platform for Hyundai and others.
companies.signal: Chapter 7 liquidation Jan 2025, ceased operations immediately; ~$164M liabilities vs $126M assets

companies.name: Geely (SEA architecture)
companies.what: Licenses and shares its Sustainable Experience Architecture across Zeekr, Volvo EX30, smart, Polestar and external partners — the closest thing to a high-volume third-party EV platform.
companies.signal: SEA underpins millions of vehicles across 6+ brands; smart JV with Mercedes built entirely on it

companies.name: VDL Nedcar
companies.what: The Netherlands' only large contract car plant; after BMW pulled the MINI contract it failed to land a replacement EV client (talks with Rivian and Canoo collapsed).
companies.signal: Car assembly ended March 2024 with thousands of layoffs; site repurposed away from vehicles (parent VDL Groep remains solvent)

companies.name: CATL (CIIC / Panshi chassis)
companies.what: World's largest battery maker selling an integrated cell-to-chassis skateboard so new entrants and legacy brands can skip platform R&D.
companies.signal: Panshi/Bedrock chassis unveiled Dec 2024; first applications with Avatr; pitching international licensees

variations.white_space: Pure skateboard startups keep dying (Canoo Ch7 2025, Arrival 2024) and contract plants keep losing anchors (Magna-Fisker, VDL-MINI) because credible volume customers barely exist — incumbents own factories and startups die before reaching volume. The model that works is Foxconn's: regional assembly inside tariff walls plus white-label platforms for legacy brands that lack EV R&D (Mitsubishi-Foxtron), and Chinese platform licensing (Geely SEA, CATL) is the likely consolidation path.

variations.name: ICE-to-EV passenger conversions & classic-car retrofits
variations.description: Specialists that remove combustion drivetrains from existing or classic cars and install electric ones, extending vehicle life and avoiding the embodied emissions of a new car — economically viable today mainly at luxury restomod price points.

companies.name: Everrati
companies.what: OEM-grade 'redefined' electric conversions of icons (Porsche 911 964, Land Rover Series, GT40) with reversible installs preserving originality.
companies.signal: Operating since 2019 with US build partners; six-figure price points and order books across UK/US

companies.name: Electrogenic
companies.what: Sells type-tested drop-in conversion kits (Land Rover Defender, Jaguar E-Type, Citroën DS) and holds UK defense contracts for electrified Land Rovers.
companies.signal: Kit network expanded to US installers in Vermont and Texas; one of the few converters with a scalable kit model

companies.name: Lunaz Design
companies.what: Beckham-backed luxury electrification of Rolls-Royce, Bentley, Aston Martin and Range Rover classics at Silverstone.
companies.signal: Sister company Lunaz Applied Technologies (electric bin lorries) entered administration Mar 2024, pausing the group; Lunaz Design resumed restructured operations May 2024

companies.name: Transition-One
companies.what: French pioneer of certified low-cost (~€5-8k) retrofit kits for mass-market cars like the Twingo and Fiat 500; helped write France's retrofit regulation.
companies.signal: Judicial liquidation Mar 2023 after a €5M raise failed — founder blamed lack of industrialization financing

companies.name: R-FIT
companies.what: Sells Renault-endorsed homologated retrofit kits for classic Renault 4, 5 and Twingo, installed through the Renault network.
companies.signal: Partnership unveiled with Renault in 2023; kits from ~€12k including battery

companies.name: Rev Mobilities
companies.what: French retrofit integrator converting passenger cars and light fleets, one of the survivors consolidating the French retrofit market.
companies.signal: Secured new investment after pioneer Transition-One was liquidated

companies.name: EV West
companies.what: Long-running California shop supplying conversion components and Tesla-crate-motor swaps that seeded the US DIY conversion ecosystem.
companies.signal: Operating since 2010s with multi-year build backlog; parts business serves hundreds of independent converters

variations.white_space: Mass-market retrofit has repeatedly failed (Transition-One liquidated despite French subsidies and a regulation written around it) because kit-plus-labor cost rivals a used BEV; only luxury restomods clear margins. The opening is standardized, type-approved kits for a handful of iconic high-volume models installed through OEM dealer networks (the Renault/R-FIT pattern), or subsidy-backed fleet retrofits where duty cycles are predictable.

variations.name: Tech & consumer-electronics entrants
variations.description: Smartphone and internet giants entering passenger EVs by leveraging brand, retail networks, software ecosystems and electronics supply-chain mastery instead of automotive heritage — compressing development cycles to ~3 years.

companies.name: Xiaomi EV
companies.what: Smartphone giant's SU7 sedan and YU7 SUV, deeply integrated with the Xiaomi device ecosystem and built in its own Beijing plant.
companies.signal: >410k vehicles delivered in 2025 (year two); 550k target for 2026; YU7 hit 150k deliveries in 6 months

companies.name: Huawei (HIMA alliance)
companies.what: Doesn't build cars itself — supplies the smart-driving stack, cockpit and retail channel to partner brands AITO (Seres), Luxeed (Chery), Stelato (BAIC), Maextro (JAC) and Shangjie (SAIC).
companies.signal: HIMA topped China's NEV-startup ranking with 57,915 deliveries in Jan 2026, ahead of Xiaomi

companies.name: Sony Honda Mobility (Afeela)
companies.what: Sony-Honda JV building the entertainment-centric Afeela 1 luxury sedan, manufactured in Ohio with Sony sensing/content stack.
companies.signal: US (California) deliveries scheduled from 2026; low-volume premium positioning

companies.name: Apple (Project Titan)
companies.what: Decade-long secret car program that cycled through full-autonomy and conventional EV concepts without ever settling on a shippable product.
companies.signal: Canceled Feb 2024 after an estimated ~$10B spend; team redirected to generative AI

companies.name: Ji Yue (Jidu, Baidu + Geely)
companies.what: Baidu-Geely 'robocar' venture selling EVs with Baidu's autonomy stack; never secured its own production license and borrowed Geely's.
companies.signal: Collapsed overnight Dec 2024 with ~RMB 7B cumulative losses and only ~14k cars delivered
